title: Global sections of tensor pullback between field spectra
statement: Let $K,L$ be fields and $f:K\to L$ a ring homomorphism. For arbitrary module sheaves on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along $\operatorname{Spec}f$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], followed by global sections and scalar transport along GammaSpecIso, is naturally isomorphic to global sections with K-scalars followed by extension of scalars along f.

proof.text: On Spec K evaluation is an equivalence by the one-point evaluation theorem. Scalar transport by GammaSpecIso is an equivalence. Thus global sections with K-scalars is an equivalence, and its left adjoint tilde is an equivalence.

Precompose the desired comparison by tilde. Use the tensor-pullback-tilde comparison, then whisker by global sections over L. The tilde-global-sections unit cancels tilde over L; insert the corresponding unit over K on the other side. Full faithfulness of precomposition by tilde lifts the resulting natural isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_fieldSpec_tensorPullback_globalSections_iso
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] (f : CommRingCat.of K ⟶ CommRingCat.of L) :
    Nonempty
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Spec.map f) ⋙
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation
            (moduleRings (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)).toRingedSpace) (op ⊤) ⋙
              ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of L)).inv.hom) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation
            (moduleRings (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).toRingedSpace) (op ⊤) ⋙
              ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom) ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars f.hom)
